title: Single-qubit detection by collective phase imprinting
summary: The amplification of quantum information carried by a single quantum excitation is a recurring challenge across diverse quantum platforms. The coupling between a single qubit and a mesoscopic ensemble of spins, for example, can be leveraged to realize non-destructive detection of the qubit state. However, realizing robust couplings between such systems is experimentally challenging and typically requires programmable quantum gates or native long-range interactions.
